messages:
Rachael (AE): Prospect pinged asking for BCP/DR text for SIG: exact RTO/RPO, backup cadence/retention, restore drill evidence, and a short failover excerpt we can attach. Need short, copy-paste answers.

Kris (Security): I'll write a concise split: Hosted vs Dedicated/Private. Keep hosted conservative and reference SLA/SOW for contract specifics.

Marta (SRE): Quick facts: control plane replicated across AZs; primary DB WAL shipped to geo-standby; object store hourly snapshots + nightly fulls; default retention 30 days; quarterly restore drills. Caches ephemeral.

Kris (Security): SIG-ready bullets (Hosted): Multi-AZ replication with geo-standby and encrypted snapshots. Target RTO (control plane) <= 1 hour. RPO for persisted customer data ~15 minutes (WAL + snapshots). Dedicated/Private: RTO/RPO configurable in SOW and can be tightened.

Marta (SRE): Failover mechanics (brief): automated health checks + routing switch to healthy cluster; for region loss promote geo-standby and update DNS. Routing switchover typically 1-5 minutes; full data restore time depends on dataset size.

Kris (Security): Backups & retention: hourly incremental snapshots, nightly full backups retained 30 days by default. Longer retention or export available as an add-on. Backups encrypted at rest and in transit (KMS/TLS).

Marta (SRE): Restore evidence: we run quarterly full restore drills; can provide sanitized screenshots and timestamped logs on request. Dedicated customers can opt for more frequent drills.

Ben (Legal): Suggested SIG wording for SLA reference: "Hosted: 99.9% monthly uptime SLA; Dedicated: 99.95% (per contract). Remedies and exclusions set forth in the SLA and SOW; avoid additional guarantees in SIG."

Marta (SRE): Runbook excerpt to attach:

1) Notify oncall and set maintenance flag
2) Trigger routing to secondary region/cluster
3) Smoke test: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api-secondary.redwood.ai/health
4) Validate replication lag <30s and sample requests succeed
5) Re-sync primary from backups and monitor until steady
Evidence: include controller logs, screenshots and runbook entry timestamp

Runbook Bot: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/dr-tests/summary (last full restore: 2025-09-08).

Rachael (AE): Thanks — I'll paste into the SIG spreadsheet and request the scrubbed drill artifacts.

Kris (Security): I'll pull the scrubbed logs and upload within 24h.

Ben (Legal): LGTM. Keep hosted numbers conservative and point to SLA/SOW for any tightened commitments.

Rachael (AE): Sending to prospect now, will update thread with any follow-ups.
